race.description: Tg Christmas Parties At The Gardens 8-15
race.comment: ALFIE'S GIRL (2) turned in a better run last time to find a minor placing (23.13) at this track behind Nitro Toxic in a Grade 5. Has the early speed to land on the pace and can stick on. The form from her last run is stacking up nicely. Rates highly and will give a great sight. SUNSHINE RHONDA (1) turned in a moderate effort last time when sixth at this track over 400m behind Boy Named Blue (23.38) in a Grade 5. Great chance to atone. CHRONIC CHARLIE (6) missed the frame last time but prior to that was an effortless Maiden winner (23.27) at this track, scoring by 5 lengths. Rates a winning chance on best. IMPERATOR (7) missed the placings here most recently but can sneak into the finish with the right run.
